context_notes.body:
# Harrington — quick huddle (Sun 27 Sep, call)
Present: Karandeep, Dhaval, Pranav

- Harrington now = 3 docs: NDA (signed Aug), MSA (their paper, in review), BAA (arrived 16 Sep — Rebecca wants it signed together with the MSA). Dhaval: "one more doc for Harrington."
- Pranav: scoping is going well. Kevin Brooks (their data eng manager) emailed a "sample extract" on 12 Sep so we could size the pipeline. Pranav opened it here and forwarded to Sneha and Vikram in Pune to start profiling. "It's real data I think — names, DOBs, some diagnosis codes."
- Dhaval: the BAA says nobody outside the US touches patient data, so he's bringing in Daniel Ortiz, freelance data engineer in Austin. Contractor agreement + NDA drafted on our US template. "US-based, so the offshore thing is solved."
- Karandeep: "Our cyber policy is $1M btw, Harrington BAA wants 5."
- Pranav asked if the CareBridge setup (the intercompany thing) covers this too — Karandeep: "should do, same kind of work." Nobody checked.
- Dhaval: Rebecca needs MSA + BAA by 1 Oct.

Let's talk Monday.

*(No decisions were made. As of 2026-09-28 no Business Associate Agreement had been signed with Harrington; the sample extract remained with the two Pune engineers; no subcontractor BAA had been drafted for Daniel Ortiz; the insurance gap was not raised with Harrington.)*
